title: 第273章 杨起家：哥你人设崩了，绿裤子不能这么猛的！
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

时间回到一段时间以前，总裁办公室内，紧张的气氛凝固到了极点。

女医蹲在地上，手中的救援针才刚准备狠狠扎在露娜的身上。

“砰——！砰——！”

就在这时，两声间隔极短、震耳欲聋的AWM枪响顺着走廊传了进来，吓得女医手都抖了两下，

“外边怎么两声AW？”

威龙靠在门边的掩体后，侧耳倾听了半秒，冷静地分析道：

“听枪声间隔，应该不是一个人打出来的，应该是两把AW在对狙！黑室那队背后看样子也来了一支尾随的队，两边现在交火了！”

说到这里，威龙的语气里明显带上了一丝庆幸：“这是好事。等露娜救起来，我们补好状态，直接摸出去和那支尾随队打个配合，把中间黑室那队夹死在走廊里！”

“对！”地上的露娜看着自己即将走满的救援进度条，恶狠狠地在语音里附和，“等我起来，我的AW终于能派上用场了！刚才偷我的那个孙子，我必须亲手送他回大厅！”

“嘀嘀—滴滴—”救援真生效的音效响起。

露娜的角色终于从地上爬了起来。但她没有第一时间打急救包，而是愣在了原地。

“快打血啊，愣着干嘛！”女医催促道。

“不是……”露娜的声音开始发颤，带着一丝难以置信的崩溃，“我……我的装备呢？”

女医和威龙闻言齐刷刷回头，一看之下，两人也全都傻眼了。

只见原本全副武装、穿着六甲背着大狙的露娜，此刻身上光秃秃的，只剩下一件单薄的初始打底衫，头戴一顶跑刀专属的“老太头”。

别说AWM和满改aSval了，连个弹挂都没给她留下，被扒得比哈夫克小兵还干净！

“你装备呢？被系统吞了？”威龙端着枪，眼珠子都快瞪出来了，“刚才也没敌人冲过来舔你的包啊！”

“我怎么知道！我倒在烟里什么都看不见！”露娜欲哭无泪，“我就只记得是被那个绿裤子背回来的……”

就在三人百思不得其解的时候。

“砰——！”

外边的走廊上，又是一声AWM的咆哮。紧接着，“哒哒哒哒”一串极其密集、如同订书机般沉闷的ASVAL消音枪声跟着响起。

“等等……”威龙的脸色瞬间变了，“这枪声的反馈……不对劲啊。这哪是第三队？这开火的位置，怎么听着就在我们隔壁的长廊口？！”

三人对视一眼，一种极其离谱的猜想同时在脑海中升起。

女医顾不上别的，直接丢了两个手术包和血药在地上给露娜，然后跟威龙一起，小心翼翼地探出总裁大门，顺着掩体往外瞄了一眼。

这一眼，差点让威龙的血压当场爆表。

走廊那边，根本就不存在他们设想中那支“尾随的第三方猛攻队”。

此刻站在掩体后，端着AWM和黑室满编队激情对狙的，赫然就是那个刚才收了他们五十万“雇佣费”，打着暗号认大哥的绿裤子蜂医！

而且最离谱的是，从刚才对面走廊尽头处的那声惨叫可以听出——这蜂医竟然已经用手里的AW，硬生生反杀掉对面一个人了？

“这……这哥们什么情况？”女医张大了嘴巴，“他哪来的AW？哪来的六级甲？”

露娜看着蜂医身上那套眼熟到了极点的装备，灵光一闪，气得差点背过气去：“那特么是我的甲！那是我的枪！那孙子在走廊背起我到跑回总裁的这四秒钟里，把我全身上下给扒光了！”

威龙倒吸了一口凉气，女医也是一脸恍然大悟。

“我说刚才丢小金他摇头，非得把那张紫卡也丢出来他才肯点头呢……”

女医喃喃自语，“合着这五十万，只是人家出手背你的跑腿费。至于帮忙打掉一队的雇佣费……人家直接自己从你身上‘提款’了啊！”

“这也太黑了吧！”露娜欲哭无泪，“不是，他一个跑刀的绿裤子，拿我的枪跟人家满编队刚正面？对面可是也有AW啊！”

“先别管黑不黑了。”威龙死死盯着回廊里的战况，咽了口唾沫，“你没发现吗，对面那个拿AW的，刚才对狙都没对过他！这群绿裤子真就各个身怀绝技，卧虎藏龙呗？”

而此时的直播间里，杨起家的视角正牢牢锁定在蜂医的身上。

回放刚才那一幕——蜂医一个极其干脆利落的闪身peek，骗出对面AW的子弹后，抓准对方拉栓的一秒钟僵直期，一枪爆头带走第一人。

“漂亮！这身法骗枪太神了！”杨起家在屏幕前猛拍大腿。

弹幕也是瞬间炸锅：

【卧槽，绿裤子零元购发威了！】

【露娜在总裁室里估计已经哭晕了，扒衣狂魔啊！】

【这准度，你跟我说这是来跑刀的？】

但战斗远未结束。对面毕竟是满编队，那个被爆头的狙击手显然十分不服气，在队友丢下的掩护烟中被迅速拉了起来。

“对面不服，还想对！”杨起家紧盯着屏幕，“但蜂医哥现在占着直架位，主动权在手里！”

果不其然，那人被拉起来打满血后，觉得自己刚才只是大意被骗了枪。他端起AWM，试图效仿蜂医刚才的操作，也来一个闪身peek反杀。

但三角洲种种基础规则里，最为忌讳的就是在绝对的直架枪线下面呆呆的露大身位。

蜂医站在墙角，连呼吸声都刻意压低，枪口的十字准星犹如死神的镰刀，稳稳锁死了那片烟雾的边缘。

Going back to some time ago, the tense atmosphere in the president's office was at its peak.

The female doctor squatted on the ground, and the rescue needle in her hand was just about to prick Luna's body.

"Bang——! Bang——!"

At this moment, two deafening AWM gunshots with very short intervals came in along the corridor, which scared the female doctor's hands and shook her head.

"Why are there two AW sounds outside?"

Weilong leaned against the bunker by the door, listened for half a second, and analyzed calmly:

"Listening to the intervals between gunshots, it shouldn't have been shot by one person, but two AWs sniping at each other! It looks like there is a team following behind the team in the black room, and the two sides are now exchanging fire!"

Speaking of this, Weilong's tone clearly contained a hint of joy: "This is a good thing. After Luna is rescued, we will regain our health and go out directly to cooperate with the following team, trapping the team in the middle black room in the corridor!"

"Yes!" Luna on the ground looked at the rescue progress bar that was about to be filled, and echoed fiercely in her voice, "When I get up, my AW will finally come in handy! The grandson who just stole me, I have to send him back to the hall with my own hands!"

"Didi-di-di-" the sound effect of the rescue really taking effect sounded.

Luna's character finally gets up from the ground.But instead of grabbing a first aid kit immediately, she froze on the spot.

"Hurry up and get some blood, why are you standing there dazed!" the female doctor urged.

"No..." Luna's voice began to tremble, with a hint of disbelief, "I... where is my equipment?"

The female doctor and Wei Long turned around when they heard this. At first glance, they were both dumbfounded.

I saw that Luna, who was originally fully armed, wearing a Rokko and carrying a large sniper, was now naked, with only a thin initial base layer left, and an "old lady's head" exclusive to Running Blade.

Not to mention AWM and full-modified aSval, she didn't even leave a bomb for her, and she was stripped cleaner than a Hafk soldier!

"Where is your equipment? Has it been swallowed up by the system?" Weilong held the gun, his eyes almost bulging out of his head, "There was no enemy rushing over to lick your bag just now!"

"How do I know! I fell into the smoke and couldn't see anything!" Luna was on the verge of crying, "I just remember being carried back by that green pants guy..."

Just when the three of them were puzzled.

"Bang——!"

In the corridor outside, there was another roar of AWM.Immediately afterwards, a series of extremely dense and dull ASVAL silenced gunshots sounded like a stapler.

"Wait a minute..." Weilong's expression changed instantly, "The feedback of the gunfire... is wrong. Where is the third team? Why does it sound like the firing position is at the entrance of the corridor next to us?!"

The three of them looked at each other, and an extremely outrageous suspicion arose in their minds at the same time.

The female doctor didn't care about anything else and threw two surgical kits and blood medicine on the ground to Luna. Then, together with Weilong, they carefully poked out the CEO's door and took a look out of the bunker.

This glance almost made Veyron's blood pressure explode on the spot.

On the other side of the corridor, there was no such thing as the "trailing third-party assault team" they imagined.

Standing behind the bunker at this moment, holding an AWM and engaging in a passionate sniper battle with a full formation in the black room, it turned out to be the green-pants bee doctor who had just accepted their 500,000 "employment fee" and used a secret code to identify his eldest brother!

And the most outrageous thing is that you can hear the scream at the end of the corridor opposite - this bee doctor has actually killed a person opposite with the AW in his hand?

"What...what's going on with this guy?" The female doctor opened her mouth wide, "Where did he get AW? Where did he get level six armor?"

Luna looked at the extremely familiar equipment on the bee doctor and had a flash of inspiration. She was so angry that she almost lost her breath: "That's my armor! That's my gun! In the four seconds between when the grandson carried me on his back in the corridor and when he ran back to the president, he stripped me naked!"

Weilong took a deep breath, and the female doctor also looked enlightened.

"I said he shook his head just now when I threw out the little gold card. He would only nod his head if he also threw out the purple card..."

The female doctor murmured to herself, "I co-authored the five hundred thousand, but I just paid for your errands. As for the employment fee for helping to kill a team... I directly 'withdrawn' the money from you!"

"This is too dark!" Luna was on the verge of crying. "No, he's a green pants guy who's running away with a knife. He uses my gun to confront a full formation? But there are also AWs on the opposite side!"

"Don't worry about whether it's dark or not." Weilong stared at the battle in the corridor and swallowed, "Didn't you notice that the guy with the AW on the opposite side couldn't even hit him in the sniper attack just now! These green pants really all have special skills, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon?"

In the live broadcast room at this time, Yang Qijia's perspective was firmly focused on the bee doctor.

Playing back the scene just now - the bee doctor peeked out of the opponent's AW with an extremely neat and neat peek, and then caught the opponent's one-second freeze when pulling the bolt, and took away the first person with a headshot.

"Beautiful! This skill is so amazing!" Yang Qijia slapped his thigh in front of the screen.

The barrage also exploded instantly:

[Holy shit, green pants are now available for zero yuan!】

[Luna must have fainted from crying in the CEO's office, she is a crazy person who takes off clothes!】

[This accuracy, you told me this is for running a knife?】

But the battle is far from over.After all, there was a full formation on the opposite side. The sniper whose head was shot was obviously very unconvinced and was quickly pulled up in the cover smoke dropped by his teammates.

"The opponent is not convinced, but still wants to be right!" Yang Qijia stared at the screen, "But Brother Bee Doctor is now in the direct position, and the initiative is in his hands!"

Sure enough, after the man was pulled up and fully hit, he felt that he had just been tricked by his carelessness.He picked up the AWM and tried to imitate the bee doctor's operation just now, and also used a peek to counterattack.

But among all the basic rules in the Delta, the most taboo is to show your body under the absolute straight gun line.

The bee doctor stood in the corner, even his breathing was deliberately lowered. The crosshair of the gun was like the scythe of death, firmly locking the edge of the smoke.
